method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (mair-core.l4, one regulative rule, s 22), date helpers (mair-dates.l4, no daydate import, no YMD) and a seat layer (mair-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Motor Accident Insurance Regulation 2018 (Qld) (sl-2018-0113), the version in force from 1 July 2026, current on 6 November 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/sl-2018-0113.txt. Not deposited and asked as facts: the s 100A lower offer limit, upper offer limit and declared costs limit of the Act; Uniform Civil Procedure Rules 1999 schedule 2 part 2 items 1 and 5; the District Court witness scale; the TORUM Act meaning of motorised mobility device.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the claimant: s 14 (gratuitous insurance of motorised mobility devices); Part 4 whole: ss 16-19 (notice of claim: form, contents, significant disability, certificates, identity evidence, consideration, records permission), s 20 (offers of settlement, capacity, court protection), s 21 (verification and payment of expenses), s 22 (information the insurer obtains); s 29 (costs if a mandatory final offer is accepted); s 30 (examination allowances); the schedule 5 definitions those use. Out: Parts 1-3 other than s 14 (classification, premiums, levies, class changes, refunds: the registered operator's seat, and 5 formulas not converted), s 15, Part 5 (licensed insurers, returns, the s 26 claim definitions), ss 28, 31-35, schedules 1-4, s 21(3).
seat: the claimant (the person injured in a motor vehicle accident who claims under the Motor Accident Insurance Act 1994, a person claiming for them, or for a death the dependants)
